label: preparing
what: A coordinated hall gathering at eighteen on day 1, involving eight installed lanterns and 200 fresh loaves: 24 delivered, 75 supplied through innkeeper, and 101 through freight on committee credit. Builder organizes and personally accepts the unfunded 101-emerald debt; baker is involved in supply and revised payment terms. Secretary knowingly assists coordination and records while reporting finances to me. The gathering's full purpose has not been disclosed; a celebration of my forty years of service is plausible but unconfirmed. Neighbour knows of lanterns and delivery efforts, and watchman knows of arrangements, but their active assistance is not established.
